dm_homogamy.definition: Pairing with a person who is similar in background, position or values.
dm_homogamy.example: Homogamy is the word for the couple who grew up in the same kind of city.

fins.definition: Flat rubber shoes for your feet. They push the water behind you so you swim faster.
fins.example: Her fins made a soft whirr in the water.

hatch.definition: To come out of an egg. A chick hatches by pushing the shell from the inside.
hatch.example: One chick hatched this morning, and it is still wet.

sodium.definition: The element that makes salt salty. A label quoting salt is quoting sodium plus the chloride with it.
sodium.example: This has 0.5 g of sodium per 100 g, which is low.

workshop.definition: The room where a robot is built and repaired. It is full of tools and smells of metal and oil.
workshop.example: Bit found shiny silver paper in the workshop.
